“How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he…

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?
translations.bsb: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
translations.kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
translations.asv: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
